column1: # Key K_OA1: Olivares to the Duke of Alba, Madrid, 22 Aug 1626 (BNE MSS/10249 ff. 13r-15r).
# = key K6A (royal cipher "A" of Philip IV, rebuilt in targets/santacruz1630/key_K6A.tsv) + 20 values learnt on the training part A of this letter only
#   (ff. 13r-14v l.17), by reading and from a fixed list of probable words; frozen by SHA-256 (da594d15...) BEFORE the held-out part H was transcribed.
# Status: PARTIAL by our protocol (one measurement on H: M5 0.506, best of 200 length-class shuffled keys 0.144; threshold 0.60 not met; validation.txt).
# Values added or changed from K6A (token: K6A value -> K_OA1 value; "(absent)" = not in K6A; "∅" = null):
# Sign "t": two forms (p and g) not separated at 120 dpi; after the blind proof-reading, the g form is written t_g in transcription.txt (value g).
# A superscript "4" on a sign (written X⁴) marks a null, as f4. Codes with no value here: 102, 197, 229, 22‡, B_, Qar, bil, bir, dol, gli, hen, hol, per, pes, yil.
# Reading decisions made AFTER the measurement, outside this key: hol = Su Majestad, gli = buena, □ = merced (not mi) at f14r.26 (see reading.md).
